faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Atal Residential School Koraon Guest Faculty Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Guest Faculty Teacher posts is 15 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the school before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the PGT posts?
faq.answer: For PGT posts, candidates must have a Master's degree in the concerned subject or any specialization, along with an Integrated Post Graduate Course from an NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks, including a B.Ed component.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty Teacher positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty Teacher posts is 50 years. Age relaxation details are not provided in the current information.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Guest Faculty Teacher roles?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the preparation of a Merit List, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the TGT (Social Studies) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the TGT (Social Studies) post is Rs. 34125 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Guest Faculty Teacher positions.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the district administration: https://prayagraj.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What are the important dates for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application start date is 01 September 2026, and the application last date is 15 September 2026. The notification was released on 27 August 2026.
